{{nihongo|'''Kaka Shrine'''|加賀神社 (松江市)}} is a shrine in {{ill|Shimane, Shimane|es|Shimane (Shimane)|ja|島根町|ko|시마네정|qid=Q7496828}}, {{ill|Matsue|ar|ماتسوا (شيمانه)|arz|ماتسوا|az|Matsue|azb|ماتسوئه|ban|Matsué, Shimané|bar|Matsue|bg|Мацуе|ca|Matsue|ce|Мацуэ|ceb|Matsue Shi|cs|Macue|da|Matsue|de|Matsue|eo|Macuo|es|Matsue (Shimane)|et|Matsue|eu|Matsue|fa|ماتسوئه|fi|Matsue|fr|Matsue|ga|Matsue|gl|Matsue|hak|Matsue-sṳ|hu|Macue|hy|Մացուե|id|Matsue, Shimane|it|Matsue|ja|松江市|ko|마쓰에시|lt|Macujė|mg|Matsue|mzn|ماتسوئه|nl|Matsue|no|Matsue (Shimane)|pl|Matsue|pt|Matsue|ro|Matsue|ru|Мацуэ|sc|Matsue|sh|Matsue|simple|Matsue|sr|Мацуе|sv|Matsue|sw|Matsue, Shimane|tg|Матсуе|th|มัตสึเอะ|tl|Matsue|tr|Matsue|tt|Матсуе|tum|Matsue|uk|Мацуе|ur|ماتسو، شیمانے|vi|Matsue|war|Matsue, Shimane|wuu|松江市|zh|松江市|zh_classical|松江市|zh_min_nan|Matue-chhī|zh_yue|松江市|qid=Q207321}}, {{ill|Shimane Prefecture|Q132751|qid=Q132751}}. It is also called Kuredo Daimyōjin. {{nihongo|'''Kaka Shrine'''|加賀神社 (松江市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izumo Province]].

== Enshrined deities ==
Its principal deity is {{ill|Kisagaihime and Umugihime|ja|キサガイヒメ・ウムギヒメ|zh|蚶貝比賣與蛤貝比賣|qid=Q11296639|lt=Kisakabihime-no-Mikoto}}<ref>{{Cite web|和書|title=松江 加賀神社（かかじんじゃ）|url=http://hakuto.tea-nifty.com/blog/2019/02/post-5677.html|website=鳥取市 白兎観光協会スタッフブログ|accessdate=2022-01-09}}</ref>, with associated deities {{ill|Izanagi|abstract|Q813858|ar|إزاناغي|az|İzanaqi|bcl|Izanagi|bn|ইজানাগি|bs|Izanagi|ca|Izanagi|cs|Izanagi a Izanami|da|Izanagi|el|Ιζανάγκι|eo|Izanagi|es|Izanagi|fa|ایزاناگی|fi|Izanaki|fr|Izanagi|he|איזאנגי|hr|Izanagi|hu|Izanagi|id|Izanagi|it|Izanagi|ja|イザナギ|ka|იძანაგი|ko|이자나기|lt|Idzanagis|mk|Изанаги|mni|ꯏꯓꯥꯅꯥꯒꯤ|no|Izanagi|or|ଇଜାନାଗି|pt|Izanagi|ro|Izanagi|rsk|Изанаґи|ru|Идзанаги|simple|Izanagi|sk|Izanagi|sl|Izanagi|sr|Изанаки|sv|Izanagi|ta|இசநாகி|th|อิซานางิ|tl|Izanagi|tr|İzanagi|uk|Ідзанаґі|vi|Izanagi|zh|伊邪那岐|qid=Q813858|lt=Izanagi-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Izanami|ar|إزانامي|az|İzanami|bcl|Izanami|bs|Izanami|ca|Izanami|da|Izanami|el|Ιζανάμι|eo|Izanami|es|Izanami|fa|ایزانامی|fi|Izanami|fr|Izanami|he|איזאנמי|hr|Izanami|hu|Izanami|hy|Իզանամի|id|Izanami|it|Izanami|ja|イザナミ|ko|이자나미|mk|Изанами|mni|ꯏꯓꯥꯅꯥꯃꯤ|pt|Izanami|rsk|Изанами|ru|Идзанами|simple|Izanami|sl|Izanami|sr|Изанами|sv|Izanami|ta|இசநமி|th|อิซานามิ|tl|Izanami|tr|Izanami|uk|Ідзанамі|zh|伊邪那美|qid=Q682306|lt=Izanami-no-Mikoto}}, {{ill|Amaterasu|Q455602|qid=Q455602}}, and {{ill|Sarutahiko Ōkami|Q3090037|qid=Q3090037|lt=Sarutahiko-no-Mikoto}}.

== History ==
The ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|abstract|Q11064932|fr|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|ja|延喜式神名帳|simple|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|zh|延喜式神名帳|qid=Q11064932}}'' includes an entry for "Kaka Shrine." It was originally enshrined in {{ill|Kaka no kukedo|ja|加賀の潜戸|zh|加賀之潛戶|qid=Q11399639}}, and later moved to its present site. In ''Izumo Fudoki-shō'' it is called "Kukedo Daimyōjin," while in ''Unyōshi'' it is called "Kuredo Daimyōjin," with Izanagi-no-Mikoto and Izanami-no-Mikoto as enshrined deities.

== Precinct shrines ==
* Higashisue Shrine
* Hinomisaki Shrine
* Nishisue Shrine
* Ebisu Shrine
* Kumano Shrine

== Festivals ==
The Shanin Festival is held on October 21, and the Otokunichi Festival on October 29<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|和書|title=島根県立古代出雲歴史博物館｜松江市の祭リスト|url=http://www.izm.ed.jp/cms/kodai/matsuri_matsue.html|website=www.izm.ed.jp|accessdate=2022-01-09}}</ref>. Like {{ill|Ise Grand Shrine|abstract|Q687168|ar|ضريح إيسه|ca|Santuari d'Ise|cs|Svatyně Ise|de|Ise-jingū|el|Μεγάλο Ιερό της Ίσε|eo|Ise-Sanktejo|es|Santuario de Ise|eu|Ise santutegi handia|fa|معبد ایسه|fi|Ise-jingū|fr|Sanctuaire d'Ise|he|מקדש איסה|hu|Iszei nagyszentély|id|Kuil Besar Ise|it|Santuario di Ise|ja|伊勢神宮|ka|ისე-ძინგუ|ko|이세 신궁|ky|Исе ибадатканасы|la|Ise Magnum Templum|lfn|Santeria de Ise|lv|Ises svētnīca|min|Kuil Gadang Ise|ml|ഐസ് ഗ്രാൻഡ് ക്ഷേത്രം|nl|Ise Jingu|no|Ise Jingū|or|ଇଶେ ମହାଶାଳ|pl|Ise-jingū|pt|Santuário de Ise|ru|Храм Исэ|sh|Veliko svetište Ise|simple|Ise Grand Shrine|sl|Veliko svetišče Ise|sv|Ise Jingū|th|ศาลเจ้าอิเซะ|tok|tomo sewi suli Ise|tr|Ise Tapınağı|uk|Святилище Ісе|vi|Thần cung Ise|zh|伊势神宫|zh_min_nan|Ise Sîn-kiong|qid=Q687168}}, a shikinen {{ill|Sengū|de|Sengū|ja|遷宮|qid=Q2271023}} is conducted every 20 years, and a boat-pulling ritual is held during the main transfer festival<ref name=":0" />.
